nota: Texto en inglés tal como aparece en la fuente. La correspondencia carpeta ↔ nombre de la Tabla 1 del artículo es por nombre (inferencia nuestra). Nada de estas definiciones es propio.
nota_variables: La fuente no publica un diccionario de variables por imagen: solo describe las 5 clases (carpetas). TODO(dato-faltante): metadatos por imagen (docs/investigacion/JO-1_fuentes_m2.md §7).

articulo.fuente: Afridi et al. (2025), Data in Brief 60, 111529, Tabla 1
articulo.texto: This category covers various distracting behaviors, such as talking to passengers, eating, drinking, or sleeping while driving.

mendeley.fuente: Mendeley Data, versión 1, descripción del conjunto
mendeley.texto: Contains any actions that go against safe driving practices, like drinking water or anything while driving, sleeping while driving, or talking with someone behind while driving.

articulo.fuente: Afridi et al. (2025), Data in Brief 60, 111529, Tabla 1
articulo.texto: Driving with complete focus, no distractions. The driver maintains good posture and a firm grip on the steering wheel while paying close attention to the road.

mendeley.fuente: Mendeley Data, versión 1, descripción del conjunto
mendeley.texto: Images showing a driver who seems to be paying attention to the road, both hands on the wheel, and concentrated or 1 hand on the steering wheel and other on the gear stick.

articulo.fuente: Afridi et al. (2025), Data in Brief 60, 111529, Tabla 1
articulo.texto: The driver is using the phone in their hand or holding it to their ear while making a phone call.

mendeley.fuente: Mendeley Data, versión 1, descripción del conjunto
mendeley.texto: When drivers talk on their phones or hold them up to their ears while driving a vehicle.

articulo.fuente: Afridi et al. (2025), Data in Brief 60, 111529, Tabla 1
articulo.texto: The driver is texting while driving, which significantly diverts their attention from the road.

mendeley.fuente: Mendeley Data, versión 1, descripción del conjunto
mendeley.texto: Pictures of drivers using their phones, whether it is to type messages or to interact with the screen.

articulo.fuente: Afridi et al. (2025), Data in Brief 60, 111529, Tabla 1
articulo.texto: The driver is turning the car, requiring full attention to ensure the maneuver is performed safely.

mendeley.fuente: Mendeley Data, versión 1, descripción del conjunto
mendeley.texto: Photographs that show drivers changing direction during turns by moving their heads or full bodies.

diferencias_entre_fuentes: Artículo y Mendeley describen las clases con palabras distintas y no coinciden en los ejemplos de «Others» (artículo: hablar con pasajeros, comer, beber, dormir; Mendeley: beber agua u otra cosa, dormir, hablar con alguien de atrás); ver docs/investigacion/JO-1_fuentes_m2.md §4 y C-5, C-8.
